summary: feat(shared-db): gate the touchSessionToken transaction behind a flag
description:
Because:

- The WATCH transaction should be easy to disable in favour of the Lua script.

This commit:

- Adds redis.sessionTokens.touchSessionTokenServerSide, default true.
- Restores the touchSessionToken_1 Lua script for when the flag is false.
- Keeps a Lua failure from rejecting the timeout promise unhandled.
